description: maximal forbids an elided terminator whose constituent could have been longer, though the longer one does not fit into a parse of text (engine §4): y could have been a b. The rejection is at the forbidden terminator, which is the one terminal expected there.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy maximal
%elidable T
%rule text x B C
%rule x y [T]
%rule y A | A B
